name: qwen-code
title_zh: 在终端里常驻的开源 AI 编程代理
tagline_zh: 不用切 IDE，不用开网页，在终端里直接对话改代码。跑测试、查报错、改文件，它自己动手，你只管验收。
tagline_en: Skip the IDE, skip the browser. Talk to your codebase right in the terminal—it edits files, runs tests, and fixes.
desc_en: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
why_zh: 它不只是补全，而是真正理解项目上下文后动手改。开源可自托管，数据不出本机，终端党无缝衔接现有工作流。
why_en: Not just autocomplete—it reads your project context, makes edits, and runs commands. Fully open-source, self-hostable, and.
limit_zh: 只认终端环境，没有 GUI 和可视化 diff 审查；复杂多文件重构需人工确认，且对超大仓库的索引速度不如商业 IDE。
limit_en: Terminal-only, no GUI or visual diff review. Large multi-file refactors need manual confirmation; indexing very large repos is slower than.
